Mapear os characterId, registrar composi: Map characterId, record both compositions and examine contributions by side: opening kills, assists, objective and total casts.
Matar um na frente do retake e voltar pa: Get a pick ahead of the retake and fall back to buy time
Medir deslocamento do planter entre o sn: Measure planter displacement from the plant snapshot to the next sample; record delay, next kill or death, and result.
Medir distâncias das finalizações identi: Measure Sheriff kill distances and the player's pistol-round hit distribution as separate series.

Medir repetição de região/ponto em round: Measure repeated regions or points across rounds, spatial variation and results of earlier versus later occurrences.
Medir se a morte foi respondida e o inte: Measure whether a death was traded and the retaliation delay; separate deaths with and without nearby allies in L.
Medir separação de um aliado do grupo pr: Measure an ally's separation from the main group, flank-route kills and deaths, and pre- and post-plant contribution.
Medir tempo até plant, inimigos vivos e: Measure time to plant, living enemies and their distance from the spike at completion using P/L/K.
Medir tempo da primeira eliminação por r: Measure first-kill time by region and side, plus first available snapshot appearances.
Métodos e limiares são propostas de anál: Methods and thresholds are proposed analytical approaches. Measurable does not mean a confirmed mistake; indicators need context. A tip being in the catalog does not mean it can be evaluated in this match.
Mostrar cinco equipamentos, gastos e sal: Show all five players' equipment, spending and balances side by side; count discrepancies and relate them to results and the next round.
Não abandonar o espaço de ligação útil a: Keep connector space that helps the post-plant
Não conclua que um adversário estará mal: Do not judge an opponent's loadout by their credits alone. A surviving teammate may have kept a weapon or be able to drop one for a player with little money.
Não continuar expondo o corpo a uma regi: Stop exposing yourself to an area occupied by multiple enemies
Não deixar o relógio encerrar um ataque: Do not let the attack run out of time before planting
Não deixar uma meia compra sem querer co: Do not let an accidental half buy compromise the planned full buy
Não dependa sempre da surpresa do mesmo: Do not always rely on the same surprising position. Change positions between rounds to catch opponents who still expect the threat in the previous area.
Não domine uma grande parte do mapa para: Do not take a large part of the map and then stop using it. Understand the space you gained and how it pushes defenders back before surrendering that advantage.
Não fique apertando o tiro da pistola o: Do not fire a pistol as fast as possible. Learn its accuracy reset timing and shoot calmly; the Sheriff, for example, requires more space between shots.
Não insistir na mesma entrada quando o a: Do not keep entering where the defense is already concentrated
Não repetir indefinidamente uma jogada d: Do not repeat the same surprise play indefinitely
Não repita apenas ir até um bombsite e e: Avoid repeatedly rushing the same site when defenders are waiting there. Work for space and reconsider the target if the same entry keeps meeting resistance.
Não sacrifique automaticamente a utilida: Do not automatically sacrifice support utility for a better pistol. In the sentinel and support examples, abilities come first; a fallen player's pistol can be recovered after the entry.
Não transforme uma economia em meia comp: Do not turn an eco into a half buy just because you can afford a pistol or shields. Save if that purchase would prevent a good weapon, shields and abilities in the next full buy.
Não usar a mesma expectativa de headshot: Use different headshot expectations for rifles, Operator and other weapons
Não usar a riqueza de um único jogador p: Do not base all five players' purchases on one wealthy player
Nas detonações, procurar defensores aind: For detonations, look for defenders not eliminated before bomb events; record inferred state and result.
Nas mortes, contar inimigos/aliados pres: At deaths, count enemies and allies in nearby regions and relate position to the player advantage.
Nas multikills de Operator, medir pontos: For Operator multikills, measure successive points, distance, movement direction relative to the site and retaliation.

No 1v2, lidar rapidamente com quem dá co: In a 1v2, handle the covering player quickly and still contest the defuse
No 1vX, procure jogar vários x1 separado: In a 1vX, seek separate 1v1 fights. Use information and space to face one opponent at a time rather than peeking two approaching together.
No afterplant contra dois, pense no joga: Consider the player covering while the other defuses. Resolve that fight quickly and use the time since the tap to decide whether to peek the defuser immediately or keep working the situation.
No clutch, depois que o adversário viu v: After being spotted in a clutch, try something different and reposition. The opponent may keep checking your previous position while you move to a stronger angle.
No pistol, a Reyna pode acompanhar quem: Reyna can follow the first player in and look for a trade. Let Jett or Raze create space so Reyna can secure a kill and use her reset to continue the round.
No pistol, buscar controle e conversão c: Seek map control and team conversion in pistol rounds, not just kills
No retake, considerar mais de uma rota e: Use multiple retake routes instead of grouping in one passage
No retake, não pense só na passagem em q: Do not focus only on the passage where everyone is grouped. The lesson discusses sending a pair around the flank to create another front.
Nos pistols, observar H, dano sem finali: In pistol rounds, examine H, damage without kills and trade results to select difficult situations.
Nos plants concluídos, medir sobrevivent: For completed plants, measure survivors on both sides, spatial distribution and planter or ally deaths soon afterward.
O afterplant começa depois de o time con: Post-plant play starts with taking the site. Control and clear the space before treating it as ready for planting and defending.
O bônus não precisa ser vencido para ter: A bonus round can be valuable without a win. Playing the third round with surviving weapons preserves enough money for a fourth-round full buy even after a loss.
O clutch muda conforme o lado e a situaç: Clutches change with your side and the spike state. Holding a planted spike lets you use position and time; retaking requires clearing space and provoking a response before time expires.
O disparo secundário da Classic é uma op: The Classic's alternate fire is strong at very close range. At distance, take controlled shots instead of treating the burst as a solution for every fight.
O pistol também é um round de controle d: Pistol rounds also involve map control and coordination. Invest in tools that let the group enter and keep fighting instead of focusing only on your pistol or kill.
O placar também pesa na decisão de força: The score matters when deciding to force. If your team is far behind and close to losing the match, risking a buy can make sense instead of giving up another eco round.
O segundo pick mais agressivo exige saíd: An aggressive second pick requires a safe exit
O timing do lurk depende do contato do t: Lurk timing depends on your team's contact on the other side. Deaths and rotations can create an opening; without that contact, someone may still be waiting for you.
Observar primeiras mortes, regiões recor: Examine first deaths, recurring punished regions and damage contribution to select entry points for review.
Observar quais agentes morreram para ent: Track which agents died to understand possible rotations
Olhe a economia adversária para pensar o: Consider the enemy economy when choosing where to fight. A player with fewer credits may change their weapon, abilities or how they hold an area, creating an opening for the attack.
Os eventos continuam disponíveis na linh: Events are still available in the timeline.
Para cada estado 1vX, registrar vitória: For each 1vX state, record objective wins, later kills and whether the survivor wins without eliminating everyone.
Pedir companhia para agressivar, em vez: Ask for a partner before making an aggressive play
Pense na compra como uma sequência de ro: Think of buying as a sequence of rounds. Keeping a bonus weapon or saving now can prepare the team for the next full buy, even if the current round ends in a loss.
Pense no que o próximo inimigo fará depo: Think about what the next enemy will do after learning where you got a kill. Change angles to catch them searching instead of fighting where they are already aiming.
Planejar a economia do round seguinte an: Plan next round's economy before spending
Planejar a próxima posição enquanto plan: Plan your next position while planting and move when finished
Plantar depois de conquistar/limpar o es: Plant after taking and clearing the necessary space
Plante em uma posição fácil para o seu t: Plant somewhere your team can play around afterward. Match the spike to positions you can hold and defend, not just the first place you can finish planting.
Preferir um off-angle que quebre a abert: Choose an off-angle that disrupts a predictable peek
Preservar vantagem numérica e não oferec: Preserve the player advantage and avoid isolated duels against the last enemy
Preservar variedade de posições para tor: Vary positions to make the retake difficult
Pressionar uma região para deslocar defe: Pressure one area to move defenders and exploit another
Preste atenção ao jeito de jogar de quem: Notice how familiar opponents play. If an enemy repeatedly avoids peeking in a situation, that pattern can inform a different decision next time.
Primeiro abate, sobrevivência posterior: Use K/R for opening kills, the opener's later survival and team conversion. Separate the opening kill from advancing and dying afterward.
Procurar distribuição defensora 1+4 nas: Look for sampled 1+4 defensive distributions and an advanced isolated player; relate to plant and result.
Procurar eliminar com vantagem de posiçã: Seek positional advantages, including catching enemies from the side
Procurar sequência de eventos/posições e: Look for events or positions on one side, defensive redistribution and a plant on the other; measure intervals and sampled defenders.
Procurar sobrevivência inferida no round: Look for inferred survival, the same weapon identifier and reduced spending in R3/R15; compare with equipment changes.
Procure ganhar pela posição, não apenas: Win through positioning, not only direct-duel aim. Create plays that catch an opponent from the side and give you an advantage before the fight.
Quando a maioria consegue comprar, o jog: A player with fewer credits can support a collective buy
Quando a mira/munição/situação falhar, d: Make yourself harder to kill when a fight goes wrong
Quando matar o adversário avançado, expl: Quickly exploit space left by an eliminated forward defender
Quando matar um defensor avançado, a dec: After killing a forward defender, decide quickly whether to use the opening. Arrive before the defense recovers and exploit players who are still out of position.
Quando o time identifica pressão em um l: When pressure is identified on one side, the player on the other can take space and responsibility there. This lets four teammates reinforce the pressured side while retaining a response to the other.
Quando só um jogador tem dinheiro e os o: When only one player has money, their purchase should not pull the whole team into a force buy. The team saves, and the wealthy player manages their weapon within that plan.
Reconstruir entradas 1vX e segmentar por: Reconstruct entry into 1vX states and segment by side, plant state, time, equipment and result.
Reconstruir o placar antes de cada round: Reconstruct the score before each round using R; relate low-resource purchases to proximity to defeat and the result.
Reconstruir quais agentes sobreviveram a: Reconstruct agents surviving at plant; compare finishing kills, assists and results by configuration.
Recuar por posições sucessivas e deixar: Fall back through successive positions and let attackers enter your sights
Reduzir possibilidades e proteger as cos: Reduce possibilities and protect your back when repositioning in a clutch
Relacionar kills locais iniciais, tempo: Relate early local kills to plant time, players arriving in samples and conversion.
Relacionar mortes em regiões avançadas c: Relate deaths in advanced regions to the nearest ally, temporal response and round result.
Relacionar os jogadores mais/menos equip: Relate better- and worse-equipped enemies to opening kills, victims and combat areas using E/K and optionally L.
Reposicione para reduzir as possibilidad: Reposition to narrow enemy options and protect your back. As new information arrives, rule out areas they can no longer occupy and focus on what remains possible.
Reservar exposições muito agressivas par: Reserve very aggressive exposure for agents with escape tools

Rounds com a primeira eliminação de um a: Rounds with the first enemy kill. Millisecond ties count for everyone involved.

Se a composição contiver o agente, medir: If the agent is present, measure first death, first kill, temporal trades and nearby teammates using K/L.
Se a entrada por duas frentes conquistou: If a split entry gained an important connector, do not automatically give it back. Keeping players there can create more post-plant options than grouping everyone on site.
Se a movimentação de entrada já rendeu u: If the entry movement has secured one or two kills, follow the opportunity onto the site. Do not leave the group stalled while the advantage allows a faster attack.
Se a última informação coloca o adversár: If the latest information places the enemy far away and you understand travel time, use the window to plant. Consider available space and time before delaying the objective.
Se errou e não consegue finalizar, não v: If you miss or cannot finish the enemy, avoid becoming an easy target. Make their shot harder to give your teammate a better chance to trade.
Se o adversário tomou uma região e você: If the enemy takes an area you cannot recover, fall back and reorganize. Adjust positions and support to the pressure instead of insisting on lost space.
Se o inimigo já está muito perto e você: If an enemy is already very close and you cannot prepare another response, a no-scope is an option. The lesson treats it as a close-range choice to practice, not a shot for every distance.
Se o plant está aberto e os agentes têm: If the plant is open and your agents have tools to play from farther back, use that option. The whole team does not have to stay on site when the objective can be defended from outside.
Se quatro conseguem comprar e só um está: If four players can buy and one cannot, that player can support the team's round. With three equipped and two short on credits, the lesson also recommends considering a key ultimate before forcing or half buying.
Se quiser agressivar, chame alguém para: Bring a teammate when pushing. Entering an area where several enemies can trade you without nearby support makes the fight much harder.
Se um defensor está vencendo todos os co: If a defender keeps winning fights in an area and you know where they are, consider attacking elsewhere. Stop repeatedly offering the situation that works for them.
Se vários inimigos já passaram para uma: If several enemies have already entered an area, do not keep taking wide peeks as though it were still first contact. Change position and seek a better fight.
Se você não sabe de onde o inimigo vem,: When you do not know where the enemy is coming from, choose a position with fewer exposed sides. Use cover and information to narrow the possible angles.
Sem ajuda, recuar; com cobertura, susten: Fall back without support; hold forward with cover
Sem informação sobre a posição adversári: Without information on enemy positions, avoid planting exposed to several sides. Use cover to reduce the ways you can be punished during the plant.
Separar cenários quatro equipados/um aba: Use E to separate four-equipped/one-below and three/two scenarios; check performance and the less-equipped players' kills and assists.
Separar equipamento registrado e fonte d: Separate recorded equipment and finishing-damage sources when interpreting H; do not penalize sniper profiles for lower headshot proportions alone.
Separar participação no objetivo, trocas: Separate objective participation, trades, opening engagements, results by phase and economy; record what the feed cannot explain.
Separar resultados da defesa antes e dep: Separate defensive outcomes before and after planting; stratify retakes by site, survivors at plant and equipment.
Separar vitórias por detonação de elimin: Separate detonation wins, elimination wins and defuse losses; calculate defuseRoundTime minus plantRoundTime and each side's final pre-defuse kill.

Treine as armas que realmente fazem part: Train with the weapons that are part of your game, not only your favorite rifle. The demonstrated routine includes pistols and Spectre as well as full-buy weapons.
Treine para melhorar a execução do time,: Practice to improve team execution, not just to win practice games. Keep roles and review successes and mistakes critically instead of justifying everything with an individual play that got a kill.
Trocar o alvo quando um defensor está do: Change targets when one defender dominates an area
Trocas, entradas, controle, rotações e l: Trades, entries, control, rotations and lurking.
Um bom off-angle fica fora da abertura d: A good off-angle is outside the enemy's usual crosshair path. Avoid the obvious corner and choose a position that forces them to adjust their aim.
Um recorte para investigar a contribuiçã: A selection to investigate opening contributions.
Uma exposição muito agressiva pede uma f: Very aggressive exposure calls for an escape after contact. In the Operator example, pushing for a second pick is recommended for agents with escape tools, not for every agent.
Uma jogada boa também pode dar errado. O: A good play can fail. Seek consistent execution that wins more often than it loses instead of abandoning a plan because an opponent hit every shot in one round.
Uma opção mais avançada é aproximar depo: A more advanced option is to move forward after the first pick, surprise a second enemy and retreat quickly. The lesson ties this risk to agents with escape tools.
Uma posição pode ser ruim contra cinco j: A position can be poor against five players and useful in a 3v3 or 2v2. Consider how many opponents can still appear and agree with your teammate on which side each will hold.
Usar a mobilidade/escape ao assumir risc: Use mobility and escape when taking pistol risks
Usar as habilidades disponíveis para cri: Use available abilities to create an opportunity
Usar E em rounds consecutivos para compa: Use E across consecutive rounds to compare current spending and balance with the next recorded loadout; highlight purchases followed by a drop in equipment.
Usar J/K para agentes vivos por instante: Use J/K for surviving agents at each instant and L for sampled positions; track later appearances in fights or retakes.
Usar K para trocas temporais em 1/3/5 s,: Use K for temporal trades in 1/3/5-second windows, response time and trading pairs; use L for participant distances when available.
Usar o bônus para chegar com economia ao: Use the bonus to fund the next round, even if you lose
Usar o secundário da Classic em curta di: Use the Classic's alternate fire at close range
Usar o snapshot anterior mais recente da: Use the future victim's latest prior snapshot. Usar o tempo da spike como condição de v: Use the spike timer as a win condition
Usar Operator em confrontos/posições ond: Use the Operator where its range can pay off
Usar plant mais protegido quando falta i: Use a safer plant when information or space is limited
Usar posições diferentes conforme a quan: Adapt positions to the number of players alive
Usar um jogador para atrair atenção enqu: Draw attention with one player while a partner punishes from another angle
Use a distância esperada para escolher a: Use the expected fighting distance to choose a pistol. The lesson recommends Ghost for longer exchanges and Frenzy when you intend to close the distance.
Use as possibilidades do espaço para que: Use the space so defenders cannot immediately locate you. Have a positioning or flank plan and be willing to change it during the clutch.
Use ⓘ to see the method and limitations.
Use o tempo desde a última informação pa: Use the time since the last information to estimate where an enemy could be. That interval may also let you reposition before they arrive and gain an unexpected advantage.
Use o tempo do plant para pensar na próx: Use the plant time to think about enemy positions and where you will go next. Finish with a plan instead of waiting until the spike is down to decide.
Use os passos e a posição dos inimigos p: Use footsteps and enemy positions to identify who arrives first. Deal with the nearest threat and adjust your position to avoid being hit from the side during the next fight.
Use suas habilidades para interferir na: Use abilities to interfere with spike play and move opponents out of comfortable positions. Utility is part of dealing with the objective, not separate from the play.

Varie a região em que começa de Operator: Change where you start with the Operator. An opponent expecting a rifle fight may encounter the weapon somewhere different from the previous round.
Ver distribuição aliada, orientações dis: Examine allied distribution, available orientations and deaths or trades near the pick; compare nearby pairs with isolated players.
